_doc: Narration for presentation_v1.0. cues = the sentence as it appears in captions and in the SRT. tts = what is actually sent to edge-tts when the reading needs help (homophones for polyphonic characters, digits spelled out); it must have the same number of entries as cues. Pronunciation notes are in docs/demo/footage_log.md. 重 meaning 'again' is read zhong4 by this voice, so the word is avoided in narration rather than patched. v1.1 (2026-09-22): voice changed from zh-TW-YunJheNeural to zh-TW-HsiaoChenNeural after the presentation review said the male voice sounded like a teenager whose voice was breaking. HsiaoChen reads more slowly, so shots 4 and 10 carry their own faster rate to fit the fixed shot lengths in plan.json. v1.2 (2026-10-26): the owner asked for a voice like a casual, energetic male talking-head creator; voice zh-CN-YunjianNeural (owner picked it from three samples), narration rewritten in a conversational tone with the same number of cues per shot, and facts brought up to date (gpt-5.6-luna, the 150-message evaluation of 2026-10-15, the weekly evaluation, 853/409 tests, PF-2 at 50%, the Threads bot running in the cloud as a test version). Shots that do not fit their fixed length carry their own faster rate.

目前是測試版，要開放給大家還得通過 Meta 審核。

cues: 那到底準不準？一百五十則標註好的訊息考下來：詐騙和假訊息一百則，全部抓到。
五十則真的訊息，沒有一則被誤判成假的；查不到出處的官方公告，系統就老實說無法查證。
每週還會拿查核機構的新結論自動考試：謠言被誤判成安全的比例，從百分之十二點八降到百分之二。
自動化測試後端八百五十三項、前端四百零九項，每次更新都會跑。
還沒過的是語意快取命中率：目標七成、目前五成，我們沒有為了過關去調低門檻。
下一步：讓機器人通過 Meta 審核、開放給大家，再用新題庫量上線後的準確率。
